title: Irrigation Water Demand
subtitle: Agronomic water budgeting & canal allocation estimates
key_finding: Total estimated crop water requirement is 347.0 MCM/year. Dual-season paddy accounts for 73.9% (256.3 MCM) of agricultural water demand, while high-intensity perennial banana accounts for 2.2% (7.5 MCM).
method: Agronomic crop evapotranspiration (ETc) and percolation budgeting using Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) and FAO-56 irrigation standards. Wetland paddy requires ~1,200 mm/season including land preparation soaking; perennial banana requires ~2,000 mm/year under tropical wetland regimes.
limitations: Effective monsoon rainfall offset (typically 400–600 mm during NE Monsoon) reduces net canal irrigation draft requirements during peak November–December flows.
